resources.string: Who\'sThatCritter is an Android application designed to help users identify animals using Google\'s ML Kit Image Labeling technology. Users can build a personal collection of identified animals and view statistics about their discoveries.

• Identify animals using AI image labeling
• Save identified animals to your collection
• View previously discovered animals
• Track collection statistics and animal rarity
Kotlin, Android Studio, Google ML Kit, Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore.
